title: Track Mix 3-Mix Duo #08 (일반 동심원·매끈 / 임산부 대각 띠·물결)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each from a different look, each with her own multi-material blended body.

#1: Ukrainian, in her late 30s, cool and composed expression, warm radiant skin tone — an enormous, overwhelmingly muscular woman. Massive thick arms with heavy defined muscle, a broad powerful muscular back, a huge powerful chest, a heavy dense muscular torso and legs, only a soft hint of a waistline. Enormous round hips and colossal thick thighs with muscle visible through a soft layer, thick heavy calves. Not slim, not lean. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, fair, luminous skin, round warm red blush high on the cheeks, dark strongly defined straight brows, soft brown eyeshadow, long lashes, large blue-grey eyes with bright real catchlights, a natural deep rose lip, and a wreath of real red poppies, blue cornflowers and wheat ears sitting on top of the head, a warm, calm expression, deep dark brown hair styled in two small space buns on top of the head, real pores, real living eyes, 5 hoops piercings set with pearls in brass-toned metal, wearing well over ten pieces, an extreme maximalist stack of silver a ring. Fused with 3 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 3 concentric regions around a single centre point located about 55% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure, separated by 2 hazy ring-shaped transition zones at about 22% and 57% of the way out from that centre point to the farthest edge of her figure. Region 1 is the innermost core around the centre point: it carries snake scales (diamond-shaped angular scales aligned in neat overlapping rows), BLAZING PALE GOLD scale formations, VIVID IVORY WHITE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 2 is the ring between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries solid thick stained glass fused to her form, hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, BLAZING ELECTRIC MAGENTA and VIVID SILVER panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane. Region 3 is the outermost region beyond the last ring: it carries polished obsidian stone fused directly to her own form, solid glossy black stone curving to follow her body's true shape, with molten gold seams running between fitted stone sections. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, perfectly circular course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The materials of every region continue in full strength over her whole figure, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: wide lunging stance, one leg forward, her extreme platform thigh-skimming boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#2: Latina, in her mid 20s, cheerful expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy, her hips and rear so wide. A high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly projects forward prominently from her front, while behind it a rear so massively rounded and projecting dominates from every angle — the rear itself curving outward and upward in a high, rounded, gravity-defying shape, echoing the belly's own roundness from the opposite side. A full round bust above the belly, gigantic thick thighs. Her head looks small on top of her body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, warm golden-bronze skin, a sharp black winged liner, warm terracotta eyeshadow, heavy lashes, strong sculpted contour, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep berry lip, a fiery, passionate expression, warm chestnut-brown hair styled in a crown braid wrapping around the head, real pores, real living eyes, 100 a mix of hoops, studs and drops piercings set with opals in rose-gold-toned metal, wearing well over ten pieces, an extreme maximalist stack of platinum a necklace. Fused with 3 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 3 diagonal bands by 2 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper right to the lower left as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 34% of the way down her figure from the top and about 58% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it carries peacock feather-eye markings (overlapping feather-barb ridges each converging into a round eye-marking with a raised rim), BLAZING ELECTRIC EMERALD eye-marking centres, VIVID DEEP BLUE radiating barb-ridge detail, every marking standing in true relief. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries koi scales (rounded smooth scales with fine visible growth rings, each scale glossy and slightly domed), BLAZING METALLIC GOLD scale formations, VIVID PLATINUM scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 3 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it carries traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, tengu feathers formations in DEEP CRIMSON and GOLD, extreme high-gloss oil finish. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The materials of every region curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: standing at a slight three-quarter angle, one hand resting on her own hip and the other beneath her belly's curve, composed radiant expression, her extreme platform high heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
